    * pubsub - A Pub/Sub mechanism allowing to publish events across all processes.

< Available methods:
 - map.generateRoom(roomName, [opts]) - Generate a new room at the specified location. 'opts' is an object with the following optional properties:
    * exits - an object with exit coordinates arrays, e.g. {top: [20,21,23], right: [], bottom: [27,28,29,40,41]}, default is random
    * terrainType - the type of generated landscape, a number from 1 to 28, default is random
    * swampType - the type of generated swamp configuration, a number from 0 to 14, default is random
    * sources - the amount of sources in the room, default is random from 1 to 2
    * mineral - the type of the mineral deposit in this room or false if no mineral, default is random type
    * controller - whether this room should have the controller, default is true
    * keeperLairs - whether this room should have source keeper lairs, default is false
 - map.openRoom(roomName, [timestamp]) - Make a room available for use. Specify a timestamp in the future if you want it to be opened later automatically.
 - map.closeRoom(roomName) - Make a room not available.
 - map.removeRoom(roomName) - Delete the room and all room objects from the database.
 - map.updateRoomImageAssets(roomName) - Update images in assets folder for the specified room.
 - map.updateTerrainData() - Update cached world terrain data.
< Available methods:
 - system.resetAllData() - Wipe all world data and reset the database to the default state.
 - system.sendServerMessage(message) - Send a text server message to all currently connected players.
 - system.pauseSimulation() - Stop main simulation loop execution.
 - system.resumeSimulation() - Resume main simulation loop execution.
 - system.runCronjob(jobName) - Run a cron job immediately.
 - system.getTickDuration() - Show current minimal tick duration (in milliseconds).
 - system.setTickDuration(minimalDuration) - Set current minimal tick duration (in milliseconds).
< Available methods:
 - bots.spawn(botAiName, roomName, [opts]) - Create a new NPC player with bot AI scripts, and spawn it to the specified room. 'opts' is an object with the following optional properties:

    * cpu - the CPU limit of a bot user, default is 100
    * gcl - the Global Control Level of a bot user, default is 1
    * x - the X position of the spawn in the room, default is random
    * y - the Y position of the spawn in the room, default is random
 - bots.reload(botAiName) - Reload scripts for the specified bot AI.
 - bots.removeUser(username) - Delete the specified bot player and all its game objects.
